title: Change in peritumoral functional network connectedness under Optune therapy in glioblastoma: a longitudinal, matched pilot study
summary: In glioblastoma, the tumor interacts with the surrounding brain networks. Stronger connections in the area around the tumor have been linked to worse outcomes. This study aims to find out whether these connections change over a period of three months during treatment with Optune. It will also explore whether certain measurements from functional MRI can serve as useful markers to better assess the disease.

interventions.name: Patients with Glioblastoma under Optune-Therapy. Addition of an extra resting-state fMRI sequence during scheduled clinical follow-up MRI scans.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Histologically confirmed glioblastoma; capacity to consent; written informed consent; sufficient proficiency in German; clinically indicated follow-up MRI scans; ongoing Optune therapy for the study group; no Optune therapy for the control group and clinical comparability.
Exclusion criteria:
Age < 18 years; lack of capacity to consent; missing or withdrawn consent; insufficient proficiency in German; contraindications to MRI; infeasibility or insufficient quality of resting-state fMRI; lack of comparability in the control group.
